mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: At Cozy Grove, we provide safe, high-quality, and compassionate care for individuals who need a home — delivered by a team that truly understands the importance of dignity, stability, and human connection. This isn't just our work — it's our calling.

home.differentiator0Body: Built from the heart by a team that treats every individual like family.
home.differentiator1Body: Nearly 20 years combined experience. Staff with pre-med, healthcare management, and advanced degrees.
home.differentiator2Body: We don't just provide support — we help individuals achieve their personal goals and live fulfilling lives.
home.differentiator3Body: Our team includes Arabic-speaking staff, ensuring culturally competent care for diverse communities.

about.title: About Cozy Grove
about.subtitle: A family-run care organization built on experience, education, and an unwavering commitment to the people we serve.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Cozy Grove was born from a deeply personal mission. Our founders grew up watching their father — a lifelong caregiver — dedicate himself to helping others. That experience shaped who they are and inspired them to build something of their own.
story.p2: After moving to Oregon and spending years working in the care industry — managing multiple homes, navigating licensing, and serving clients through some of the toughest times including COVID — they knew it was time to open their own doors.
story.p3: Today, Cozy Grove is a true family operation. What started as a calling has become a company built on real-world experience, advanced education, and an unwavering commitment to doing right by every individual we serve.

team.title: Our Team
team.body: Our team brings nearly 20 years of combined experience across 5 successful care homes in Oregon. We include a co-founder with a pre-med background from Oregon State University, staff with Master's degrees in Healthcare Management, a team member pursuing a pre-med degree at Portland State University, and incoming staff with Master's and PhD-level education. Our admin team is bilingual in English and Arabic.

values.title: Our Values
values.v0Body: Every individual deserves to be treated with care and humanity.
values.v1Body: We communicate openly with families, coordinators, and our team.
values.v2Body: Our goal is to equip individuals with skills and confidence to thrive.
values.v3Body: We believe in building connections — for our clients and within the communities we serve.

careHome.headline: 24-Hour Certified Care Home
careHome.subheadline: A safe, supportive home in Scappoose, Oregon for individuals who need around-the-clock care.

whatWeOffer.title: What We Offer
whatWeOffer.body: Our certified care home provides 24-hour support through the Supported Living Program (SLP) for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Every day is designed around comfort, dignity, and personal growth.

ourHome.title: Our Home
ourHome.body: Our Scappoose property has been fully renovated within the last 14 months and is designed to feel like a true home — not a facility. Transportation is available for community activities, medical appointments, and outings.

whoWeServe.title: Who We Serve
whoWeServe.body: We serve individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities who are classified for SLP / 24-hour care through Oregon's support coordination system.

dsp.headline: Direct Support Professional Services
dsp.subheadline: Skilled, compassionate support to help individuals thrive in their homes and communities.

whatIsDsp.title: What is a DSP?
whatIsDsp.body: A Direct Support Professional (DSP) is a trained caregiver who provides personalized assistance to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. DSPs help with daily living, community participation, and building independence — working alongside the individual, not for them.

approach.title: Our Approach
approach.body: We take a person-centered, goal-oriented approach to every support plan. Our DSPs work to foster independence, build skills, and support each individual in reaching their personal goals and living a fulfilling life.

serviceTypes.title: Service Types
serviceTypes.body: We provide DSP (Direct Support Professional), DSA (Direct Support Associate), and Relief Care services tailored to each individual's needs and schedule.
